headline: Indonesian Farmers Shift from Rubber to Oil Palm, Adding Pressure on Global Rubber Supply
summary: Attractive oil palm prices and labor costs are prompting Indonesian farmers to convert rubber acreage to oil palm. The shift is shrinking Indonesia's rubber area and output, which could affect global natural rubber supply.
why: Indonesia is one of the world's largest natural rubber producers, so changes in its output feed directly into global rubber prices used by tire and industrial manufacturers. Palm oil is a major vegetable oil traded globally.
